title: #AngryVeteran GOP Power Grab EXPOSED: North Carolina’s Democracy Under Attack with SB 382 #politics
description:
The GOP is at it again, and this time, they’re targeting democracy itself in North Carolina. Senate Bill 382 is a brazen attempt to rewrite the rules and consolidate power into the hands of the Republican Party. This unconstitutional bill strips the governor of the ability to nominate judges and instead hands that power directly to the Party. Not an elected official, but the Republican Party itself would control judicial nominations before sending them to the state Senate. This is the latest in decades of GOP efforts to cheat North Carolinians through gerrymandering, voter suppression, and attacks on election integrity.

In this video, we break down SB 382, explain how it violates the state constitution, and show why this is part of a larger Republican strategy to undermine democracy when they lose. Don’t miss this deep dive into the GOP’s ongoing war on fair governance and the shocking consequences for North Carolina’s future.

📢 Stand against this attack on democracy—watch now and join the conversation!
